Dear Mrs. Borrelli,
I hope you are doing well.
Thank you for raising the issue.
We have identified that either or both door of the charger is open.  If the door not closed properly. The charger shutdown automatically for safety reason.
Can you please reopen and close the door?
I have also forwarded the incident to the reason. A technician will contact with you as soon as possible.
Mit Freundlichen Grüßen/ Melhores Cumprimentos/ Best Regards
Harun Ar Rashid
Technical Support Specialist (eMobility)
Av. 25 de Abril 201, 2845-547, Corroios, Portugal.
